data: Is the value of the blue circle in the first plot (top left) greater than the value of the red square in the same plot?

The question asks whether the value of the blue circle in the first plot (top left) is greater than the value of the red square in the same plot. 

From the caption, we know that the blue line represents CorEx, the red square represents LDA, and the blue circle represents Sparse CorEx. 

Looking at the top-left plot, we can see that the blue circle (Sparse CorEx) is positioned above the red square (LDA) for all values of the x-axis. This indicates that the value of the blue circle is indeed greater than the value of the red square in this plot. 

Therefore, the answer is yes.
